question: Based on DHL Group's consolidated segment reporting for fiscal year 2025, which of the five operating divisions (Express, Global Forwarding, Freight, Supply Chain, eCommerce, Post & Parcel Germany) had the highest EBIT margin (EBIT divided by total division revenue), and what was that margin to one decimal place?
reference_answer: The Express division had the highest EBIT margin in FY2025: EBIT of €3,162 million on total revenue of €24,430 million, i.e. 12.9%. The other divisions were lower: Post & Parcel Germany 5.8% (€1,032 million / €17,874 million), Supply Chain 6.5% (€1,161 million / €17,778 million), eCommerce 5.5% (€379 million / €6,884 million) and Global Forwarding, Freight 4.1% (€756 million / €18,643 million).

question: Among DHL Group's five operating divisions, which one recorded the largest absolute reduction in average full-time equivalents (FTEs) between fiscal year 2024 and fiscal year 2025, and by how many FTEs did it fall?
reference_answer: Post & Parcel Germany had the largest reduction: average FTEs fell by 3,723, from 157,337 in 2024 to 153,614 in 2025. Next was Supply Chain (-3,492, from 185,413 to 181,921), then Express (-2,498), Global Forwarding, Freight (-1,648) and eCommerce (-670).

question: Looking at DHL Group's consolidated net debt at each year-end from 2020 through 2025, at which year-end was it lowest, and what was the figure (in € million) and the next-lowest year-end?
reference_answer: Net debt was lowest at December 31, 2021, at €12,772 million. The next-lowest was December 31, 2020 at €12,928 million. The other year-ends were higher: 2022 €15,856 million, 2023 €17,739 million, 2024 €18,998 million and 2025 €21,516 million (the highest). The 2020 value comes from the 2024 annual report; 2021-2025 from the 2025 annual report.

question: Did DHL Group reach its own forecast for free cash flow including acquisitions and divestitures in fiscal year 2025, as published on March 5, 2025? Compare target and result, and say whether the target for free cash flow excluding acquisitions and divestitures was reached.
reference_answer: No. The target for free cash flow (including acquisitions and divestitures) was around €2.75 billion, while the 2025 result was €2.3 billion, i.e. below the target. By contrast, free cash flow excluding acquisitions and divestitures exceeded its target of around €3.0 billion, coming in at €3.2 billion.

question: Was DHL Group's consolidated net cash from operating activities in fiscal year 2025 the highest of the five years 2021 to 2025? Give the figures.
reference_answer: No. Net cash from operating activities was €9,119 million in 2025, which was only the fourth-highest of the five years. It was exceeded by 2022 (€10,965 million), 2021 (€9,993 million) and 2023 (€9,258 million); only 2024 (€8,722 million) was lower. Figures for 2021-2024 are shown as adjusted in the 2025 annual report.

question: How did DHL Group's return on sales (EBIT divided by revenue) evolve from fiscal year 2021 to fiscal year 2025?
reference_answer: Return on sales fell in each year from 9.8% in 2021 to 8.9% in 2022, 7.8% in 2023 and 7.0% in 2024, and then recovered to 7.4% in 2025. (2021-2024 are the adjusted figures shown in the 2025 annual report.)

question: According to DHL Group's 2025 annual report, how did consolidated material expense develop in fiscal year 2025, and what did the report give as the main reasons?
reference_answer: Material expense fell from €42,766 million in 2024 to €40,910 million in 2025, chiefly due to lower transport costs in the Global Forwarding, Freight division and lower costs for aviation fuel in the Express division.

evidence.text: Material expense fell from €42,766 million to €40,910 million, chiefly due to lower transport costs in the Global Forwarding, Freight division and lower costs for aviation fuel in the Express division.

question: The Express division's 2025 EBIT of DHL Group included a negative net non-recurring effect. If that effect were excluded (added back), what would Express EBIT and the EBIT margin on the division's 2025 revenue have been? Give the EBIT in € million and the margin to one decimal place.
reference_answer: Reported Express EBIT was €3,162 million, including a negative net non-recurring effect of €129 million (restructuring, legal provisions and M&A effects). Excluding it, EBIT would be €3,291 million, and on revenue of €24,430 million the margin would be 13.5% (versus the reported 12.9%).
